extensions.description: Structured Urbanomy input; constraints_json supports scalar parameter extraction.

constraints_json.description: For optimization: JSON object of explicit bounds, e.g. {"l":{"min":1,"max":8}}. Do not invent limits. Overrides profile bounds per parameter; without a profile omitted variables stay fixed.

constraints_profile.description: Optional test preset: footprint 1 m² to 10% of site area, floors 1–10, MXI 0.1–1, all shares 0–1. Explicit bounds override it.

operation.description: Choose land valuation or district scenario optimization.

project_id.description: Optional project label, saved in provenance; does not select data.

scenario_id.description: Prepared scenario directory under DATA_DIR. Use list_scenarios; never infer an id.

target_id.description: Exact block id from the dataset, as a string. Never invent an id.

use_llm.description: Default true. False explicitly disables strategy scoring.

description: Land valuation and constrained NSGA-II district optimization with LLM strategy scoring.
name: Urbanomy

skills.description: Predict target and dataset land value from registered spatial data.
skills.name: Оценка земли

skills.description: Evaluate constrained scenarios and return a Pareto front with economic metrics and optional LLM scores.
skills.name: Оптимизация квартала
